name: PCIe add-in card
description: Card-edge PCIe device: endpoint silicon or FPGA, 12 V/3.3 V slot power, reference clock, and card-edge gold fingers per the CEM spec.
electrical_characteristics: Gen3 8 GT/s and above: tight impedance, AC coupling, via stub control
current_power_characteristics: up to 75 W from the slot
critical_electrical_constraints: Lane pairs 85 ohm differential (Gen3+) per CEM with AC coupling capacitors on TX
Gold-finger geometry per CEM; chamfer in the outline
stackup_recommendations: 4 to 8 layers with every high-speed layer adjacent to a reference plane; stackup from the fabricator's impedance table recorded in the profile
Differential 90/100 ohm and single-ended 50 ohm geometries computed per layer
placement_rules: Memory close to the controller along the bus direction; series terminations at the driver
Decoupling per the SoC/FPGA power-delivery guidance (count and value per rail)
Connectors for high-speed interfaces at the board edge with the shortest path to the PHY/SerDes
Clock generators central to their loads
routing_rules: Length match within the interface specification (DDR byte lanes, differential intra-pair, lane-to-lane)
No reference-plane crossings; stitching capacitors where a reference change is unavoidable
Via count minimised on multi-gigabit lanes; back-drill or short stubs when the fabricator offers it
Differential pairs with symmetric routing and spacing from other signals >= 3x the trace width
copper_ground_requirements: Unbroken reference planes; plane splits never under high-speed routes
Ground stitching vias at every layer transition of a high-speed signal
thermal_considerations: SoC/FPGA power dissipation at full load with heatsink or copper area per the datasheet
emi_emc_considerations: Edge-rate control, termination and reference continuity; clock spread spectrum where allowed
Shielded connectors with a chassis ground ring
protection_requirements: ESD on every external high-speed port with low-capacitance TVS placed at the connector
verification_requirements: Impedance per layer verified against the fabricator calculator
Reference-plane continuity check for every high-speed net
Power sequencing recorded from the SoC datasheet
manufacturing_constraints: Controlled impedance order; ENIG; via-in-pad with fill where BGA pitch requires
Fabricator capability check for the finest pitch and smallest via
unsupported_conditions: Lane impedance left at 100 ohm by default
